data.name: Aliyat
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'alaa' which means 'to raise, to exalt, to be high, noble, or sublime'. The name Aliyat refers to someone who is exalted or sublime, and carries the connotation of nobility, grace, and gentleness.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the journey towards spiritual enlightenment and the pursuit of a higher consciousness.

in_arabic.name: عليات
in_arabic.meaning: عليات تعني الرفعة و العلو في الدين و الدنيا
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عليات مشتق من العلو و الرفعة، و يعني الارتفاع في الشأن و المكانة، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني رفيعة و محمودة في الإسلام، حيث يدل على علو همة الشخص و رفعة شأنه في المجتمع

in_urdu.name: علیات
in_urdu.meaning: علیات مطلب ہے رفعت، بلند مقام، عزت
in_urdu.long_meaning: علیات نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ 'علو' اور 'رفعة' سے مشتق ہے، جو بلند مقام، رفعت اور عزت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمان معاشرے میں روایتی اور مذہبی اہمیت رکھتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अलीयत
in_hindi.meaning: अलीयत का अर्थ है उच्च पद, सम्मान, और उत्कृष्टता
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलीयत नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ उच्चता, पदोन्नति और उत्कृष्टता है, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में पारंपरिक और आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है

in_pashto.name: عليت
in_pashto.meaning: عليت د عزت او لوړتوب معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: عليت نوم د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د عزت، لوړتوب او ویاړ معنی لري، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو او مذهبي ارزښتونو سره تړاو لري

in_english.name: Aliyat
in_english.meaning: Excellence, elevation, high status, and nobility
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aliyat originates from the Arabic root 'ʿ-l-w', which conveys meanings of elevation, highness, and superiority. In Islamic tradition, Aliyat symbolizes elevated status, moral excellence, and spiritual growth. Historically, names derived from this root have been associated with leadership, nobility, and high esteem in Muslim societies

data.cultural_impact: The name Aliyat has a rich history in Islamic culture, particularly in the context of the important figures Ali ibn Abi Talib and Fatima al-Zahra, the Prophet Muhammad's cousin and son-in-law, and his beloved daughter respectively. The names Ali and Fatima are considered some of the most noble and revered names in Islam, and the names Aliyat and Fatimah (variants of Fatima) share the same root. The name Aliyat carries a sense of dignity, nobility, and high status, making it a respected and honorable name in Muslim communities.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Aliyat can be seen as a reminder of the divine faith and trust in Allah (God). The idea of being exalted or raised up to a higher plane can be interpreted as a call to spiritual growth and an aspiration to attain nearness to Allah. The name Aliyat can serve as an inspiration to strive for a life of nobility, virtue, and piety, reflecting the divine attributes of grace, mercy, and compassion. Additionally, in Sufism (Islamic mysticism), the concept of being raised up to a higher spiritual level is a central theme, making the name Aliyat a powerful reminder of this journey towards spiritual enlightenment.
